dataset.assessment: Conditionally usable for analysis and derived statistics, but unsuitable as the sole scientific dataset.
dataset.release_rule: Do not include the raw CSV, archive, or 933-row validation header in the public release; provide acquisition and regeneration instructions instead.

code.assessment: MIT is suitable for author-owned source. Dependencies are named in requirements.txt and installed separately.

figures.assessment: Author-generated plots and diagrams from project results; no imported image asset call was found in the generator. Dataset attribution remains required.

screenshots_and_third_party_images.assessment: No submission figure requires third-party image permission on current evidence.

references.assessment: Bibliographic facts may be reused; abstracts, figures, and substantial paper text were not copied.

submission_blockers: The draft repeatedly labels normalized values as kWh even though inverse scaling is unavailable.
The draft contains only five references and predates the verified Phase 23 related-work matrix.
The timing description uses three 16,000-inference runs rather than the later Phase 12 thirty-batch result.
A corpus-backed similarity report has not yet been reviewed by the author.

secret_scan.note: Private data paths and credential files were excluded; this is a pattern scan, not a guarantee.

definitions.copyright_infringement: Unauthorized exercise of a copyright owner's exclusive rights; citation alone does not create permission.
definitions.plagiarism: Presenting another person's words, ideas, structure, images, or methods as one's own without adequate acknowledgment; primarily an academic-ethics issue.
definitions.proper_citation: Accurate acknowledgment that lets readers identify the source; it does not replace a required copyright license or permission.

must_complete: Update every unverified kWh label to normalized target units.
Rewrite the manuscript from Phase 20-23 evidence and insert the verified related-work bibliography.
Keep raw Kaggle data and the full 933-row validation vectors outside the release; retain only the eight regression vectors embedded in the generated model header.
Retain source generators and hashes for every submitted figure and table.
Run iThenticate or Turnitin on the final manuscript and review each match manually.
Recheck the target venue's author, AI-use, preprint, and figure-permission policies.
